completed.notes: Both faces, and it verified the game is REAL: character spawns at (320,240), falls to rest at y=296 on a floor whose top face is y=320, walks right under axis_x 1.0, stops at x=585 against the wall at x=624. Windowed composition verified end-to-end (logs 4/4 parallax layers, so PlatformerAssetsPlugin genuinely ran); a real window is impossible on this box.

first_engine_file_reason: Where `Block`, `Vec2` and `AuthoredWorld` live. The README's worked example CALLS `Block::solid` and never says which module exports it; `ambition::app::prelude` carries `RoomSpec` but not `Block`; and api-prototype.md §5 ACTIVELY DENIED `ambition::world::prelude` exists. One documentation sentence, two engine crates opened.

engine_api_surfaces_read.looking_for: ModuleDraft's method signatures and MINIMAL_CHARACTER_ROSTER_RON's character id, which the README did not state

compared_to_baseline.first_file_reason: cannot compile the engine -> cannot find one type -> cannot find the feature list -> cannot find the ROOM VOCABULARY, because a doc denied it existed
compared_to_baseline.reading: Four runs. The surfaces read halved twice. Every remaining open is now a DOCUMENTATION defect rather than an API one — run 4's own summary: 'everything about HOST COMPOSITION is documented well enough to work blind, and everything about AUTHORING A ROOM is not.'

findings.summary: §5 said `ambition::world::prelude` and `ambition::character::prelude` 'are slice-B surfaces and are not invented here'. `world::prelude` shipped in slice C. Written in slice A, made false in slice C, read by a consumer in slice F.
findings.why_it_matters: THIRD stale-doc finding in four runs, and the pattern is now the finding: a doc that enumerates what does NOT exist must be re-read every time something starts existing, and nothing enforces that. §5 is explicitly an OUTPUT read off the call sites, which makes it the most trustworthy-looking list in the SDK.

findings.summary: The README spends a paragraph on the +y-down / min-corner trap without ever showing the constructor call the trap applies to. Five lines would have made the run doc-only.
findings.fix: A full worked room in the README, reproduced VERBATIM and executed by `the_sdk_worked_room_example_compiles_and_runs`.

findings.summary: MINIMAL_CHARACTER_ROSTER_RON declares `my_hero`; the README's skeleton writes `"my_hero"`; neither said they were the same thing. Confirmed only by dumping the constant out of rustdoc.
AssetSource appears in the module list and in api-prototype's manifest example, so the agent assumed it was required. It is not.

On a display-less box the windowed face needs the same 'did it start' loop, and `without_gpu()` was shown as a bare expression. Odd place to economise, given the doc's thesis is that composing is not running.
A default debug link of the bevy graph blew an 11 GB budget; rust-lld died with SIGBUS and an LLVM stack dump that never mentions disk.
+y-down and min-corner are stated; what AuthoredWorld::new's `size` and `spawn` mean, and where the room origin is, are not. The agent guessed correctly and says it had no way to know.

what_worked: The bevy_winit panic text was quoted accurately enough to be recognised instantly — 'the single most useful sentence in that document'.
`host_status`/`is_running`/`is_refused`: 'precisely the API I would have wanted and would otherwise have faked with world().entities().len()'.
`no_audio()` flagged as not cosmetic meant it never hit the Activating hang.
`ambition::actor` + `ambition::sim` let it prove the character WALKS — 'the difference between this report and one that says it compiled'.
The patch-table rev matched the workspace root verbatim.
verdict: Closest run yet: 2 surfaces, both cargo doc, and the only reason for either was one sentence in an SDK doc that denied a shipped module existed. Run 4's own summary is the campaign's status in one line — host composition is documented well enough to work blind; authoring a room was not.
